categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes PSBT handling and creation interfaces in src/psbt.h, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, and wallet-facing GUI dialogs.
categories.rationale: Defaulting to PSBTv2 causes signing failures on hardware wallets and external signing tools that only support BIP-174 (PSBTv0). As noted in issue #36518 and the PR description, GUI users are currently unable to sign exported PSBTs on incompatible hardware devices, making this a significant interoperability fix.
